title: A Ember for the Oath Again
author: Ada Reyes
blurb: Bram Eastwick, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
